images.prompt: Editorial illustration for a B2B webinar titled "From Hype to High-Impact: How to Start and Scale AI in HR", hosted by Darwinbox. Speakers: Q Hamirani, Chief People Officer at HighLevel, Sudi Bjornstad Korba, Senior Vice President of Sales, North America at Darwinbox. The session covers: Global scalability and local compliance are non-negotiable when choosing HR tech for multinational teams.; Embedded analytics in HRIS eliminate the need for a dedicated people analytics team to start gaining insights.; AI in HR should be evaluated by whether it enables 'doing more with less' without sacrificing human judgment in sensitive areas.. Design a YouTube thumbnail background in a 16:9 aspect ratio. Art direction from the session's own thumbnail brief: **Composition**: Q Hamirani on the left speaking, Sudi Bjornstad Korba on the right listening, both in professional attire, with a subtle AI neural network graphic overlay in the background connecting them; Darwinbox logo positioned at the bottom right corner. **Text overlay**: Headline: "AI as Capacity Unlock" (under 6 words); Secondary stat: "1800 employees across 10 countries" using the real data point from EXTRACTION.data_points. **Colors**: Darwinbox brand palette — primary blue #0066FF, secondary gray #6B7280, accent green #10B981, and white #FFFFFF for text contrast. Leave the upper-left third visually calm as clear space for a headline. Render pure imagery only: absolutely no words, letters, numerals, captions, logos or typography anywhere in the frame (text is added separately downstream).
